entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Substate chosen when the UE is searching for PLMNs or SNPNs. Not applicable to non-3GPP access.

entities.name: NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: Substate entered when a cell has been selected.

entities.name: LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: Substate entered when a cell has been selected.

entities.name: NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: Substate entered when it has been concluded that no cell is available.

entities.name: Cell selected
entities.description: Condition when a cell has been selected, leading to transition to NORMAL-SERVICE or LIMITED-SERVICE.

entities.name: No cell available
entities.description: Condition when it has been concluded that no cell is available, leading to transition to NO-CELL-AVAILABLE.

relations.description: Cell selection condition establishes transition to NORMAL-SERVICE state.
Cell selection condition establishes transition to LIMITED-SERVICE state.
No cell available condition establishes transition to NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
PLMN-SEARCH state transition is guarded by cell selection condition.
PLMN-SEARCH state transition is guarded by no cell available condition.
